cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallEdges
cc:Work.dc:description:
Shows the different edge types for wall systems
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallEdges --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --walltype 'plain reinforced' --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallEdges --walltype --reference --labels
